C8 (linked to PF3, owned by A4): FAILED in rollouts 0, 1; PASSED in rollouts 2, 3. In all four rollouts, A4 revealed PF3 and PF3 was cited in justification_fact_ids. The decision value is semantically correct but does not match the exact string the check requires.
